query:
SELECT 
  a.id,
  a.employeeId,
  e.fullName,
  a.date,
  a.clockInTime,
  a.clockOutTime,
  a.shiftLabel,
  a.status
FROM attendance a
LEFT JOIN employees e ON a.employeeId = e.id
WHERE DATE(a.date) = '2026-05-09'
  AND a.clockInTime IS NOT NULL
  AND a.clockOutTime IS NULL
ORDER BY a.employeeId, a.clockInTime;
